name: HARNLEN
recent: Harn Len 于2026年11月26日宣布拟以1,500,001令吉收购 Rompin Integrated Pineapple Industries 全部股权。公司近期持续进行股份回购，并于11月24日召开第26届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。最新季度（2026年8月31日止）营收同比增长31.3%，但净利同比大幅下滑88.7%。
notable: 拟以1,500,001令吉收购 Rompin Integrated Pineapple Industries 全部股权。
第26届常年股东大会所有决议均获股东通过。
近期持续进行股份回购。
risks: 存在重大诉讼事项（2026年10月29日公告）。
最新季度净利同比下滑88.7%，净利率由6.5%降至2.7%。
earnings: 2026年8月31日止季度营收为93,081,233令吉，环比增长31.4%，同比增长31.3%；净利为2,531,172令吉，环比下降45.0%，同比下降88.7%；净利率为2.7%，低于上一季度的6.5%。

recent_en: Harn Len announced on 26 November 2026 a proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Rompin Integrated Pineapple Industries for RM1,500,001. The company has been actively buying back shares and held its 26th AGM on 24 November, with all resolutions passed. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue rose 31.3% year-on-year but net profit fell 88.7% year-on-year.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Rompin Integrated Pineapple Industries for RM1,500,001.
All resolutions at the 26th AGM were passed by shareholders.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit fell 88.7% year-on-year, with net margin declining from 6.5% to 2.7%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM93,081,233, up 31.4% QoQ and 31.3% YoY; net profit was RM2,531,172, down 45.0% QoQ and 88.7% YoY; net margin was 2.7%, down from 6.5% in the previous quarter.
